channel.title: Journalist Mode
channel.description: Stable macOS updates for Journalist Mode.

item.description:
Journalist Mode 0.8.0

New
- Follow macOS desktop: an optional Settings switch. When you move to another Mission Control desktop, today's journal window selects and zooms the Doing stream with the same number, without taking focus from the app you switched to.
- In-app updates: daily checks, your choice when to install, and a save-or-discard step for every open journal before the app relaunches.
- Keyboard shortcut reference in every day window, and pane hints while Command is held.
- Up and Down select a day in the day picker; Return opens it.
- Pasted Todo tasks receive today's date, including multi-line pastes.
- Editor padding scales down as panes narrow; Todo date tags are easier to read.

Fixed
- Journal window cycling wraps at both ends and keeps full screen.
- Reopening the running app focuses an existing window.
- Command-Shift-C copies a Todo task without moving focus.
- Control-Option-H toggles completed history in the focused Doing pane.
